# 4. System components

## 4.6 Sandbox claim

The claim is a lease the gateway grants.
The lease renews while the session runs.

### 4.6.1 Renewal

The renewal is idempotent.

## 4.8 Workspace plan

The plan is authored beside the session.
The plan is versioned with the workspace.

## 4.9 Egress

Egress is denied unless a policy admits it.
